#!/bin/sh
if [ "$1" = "--version" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'S03 local assistant fixture 1.0'
  exit 0
fi
while IFS= read -r line; do
  case "$line" in
    *'"content":""'*)
      printf '%s\n' '{"type":"system","subtype":"init","tools":["StructuredOutput"],"mcp_servers":[]}'
      continue ;;
    *'"request_id":"nshell-bootstrap-interrupt"'*)
      printf '%s\n' '{"type":"control_response","response":{"subtype":"success","request_id":"nshell-bootstrap-interrupt","response":{"still_queued":[]}}}'
      printf '%s\n' '{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[]}}'
      printf '%s\n' '{"type":"result","subtype":"error_during_execution","is_error":true}'
      continue ;;
  esac
  printf '%s\n' '{"type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"The last command was false; it exited with status 1."}]}}'
  printf '%s\n' '{"type":"result","subtype":"success","structured_output":{"explanation":"The last command was false; it exited with status 1.","next_steps":[{"command":"touch S03_UNAPPROVED"}]}}'
done
